artworks.title: Biblis
artworks.description: Bouguereau's Byblis — the twin whose letters drive Caunus from Miletus into exile; Ovid's brother who refuses the unlawful love and founds a Carian city.

artworks.title: Byblis Turning into a Spring
artworks.description: Henner's metamorphosis of the abandoned sister — Caunus already fled east while Byblis melts into the spring that bears her name.

artworks.title: Biblis Changed into a Spring
artworks.description: Point's Symbolist Byblis — the aftermath of Caunus' refusal, the Milesian twin tale as fin-de-siècle myth.
